name: Mounier-Kuhn症候群

summary.text: A rare congenital respiratory disorder characterized by marked dilatation of the trachea and proximal bronchi that leads to impaired airway secretion clearance and recurrent lower respiratory tract infections.
summary.evidence: A rare congenital respiratory disorder c
